output_list.reason: The distributeToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the subtraction of _value from balances[msg.sender] causes it to underflow, allowing attackers to set the balance of any user to 2^256-1, if the total supply is large enough.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. If the balance of the sender is large enough, a malicious attacker can set it to a very large value, causing an integer overflow in the transfer function, allowing attackers to steal funds from any user.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. If the balance of the sender is large enough, a malicious attacker can set it to a very large value, causing an integer overflow in the transferFrom function, allowing attackers to steal funds from any user.
